title: Signal: MySQL server or driver error text disclosed in a response

check.valuePattern: (?:Can't connect to (?:local )?MySQL server|mysqli_sql_exception|mysqli::__construct\(\)|MySQL server has gone away|mysql_connect\(\)\s*:)

scope: One response body containing a MySQL/MariaDB connection or driver error string.
limitations: One response body. The check reads the message text; it does not confirm that the database is reachable from the network, and it cannot tell an operator-facing health page from a public one.

observation.body: Can't connect to MySQL server on 'db' (111)

fpNotes: A documentation page that quotes these messages verbatim is reported; a health endpoint that returns only a boolean is not.
